return_point.focus: Descriptions of groups: direction of an Every statement
return_point.activity: A tray is described only by “Every triangular piece in this tray is green.” Could a selected green piece from this tray be square? Explain whether that would break the description.
return_point.scope: The examples describe trays of pieces using familiar colors and shapes. A selected piece exists in the stated tray. Each conclusion must use only the stated description; other properties of the tray are not supplied. Formal symbols and technical logic vocabulary are not part of this step.
